title: chore(helper): update dependency to algoliasearch-helper
body: Update algoliasearch-helper dependency to 2.19.0 which contains the access to raw results in the SearchResults. CC. @proudlygeek ;)

comments.body:
To update the helper you need to bump it in packages/react-instantsearch.

To avoid any locking/upgrade issues, restart from v2 branch, checkout it, do `yarn boot`, the yarn.lock file should not change at all, then:

```
cd packages/react-instantsearch
yarn add algoliasearch-helper@2.19.0
```

Then you should be good, right now this PR is rolling back some package to old versions and adds the helper at the root level (instead of in packages/).

Let me know if you need help on this.
Thanks for hints @vvo. Will update that!
